content: Floci (floci-io/floci, MIT, ~18.3k GitHub stars, v1.5.11+) is a Quarkus/GraalVM-native LocalStack-Community drop-in replacement (~90MB image, ~24ms startup). Supports Glue Data Catalog + Schema Registry + Athena-via-DuckDB sidecar (floci-duck) but the README service matrix does not list Glue jobs, crawlers, or BatchCreatePartition as supported operations -- absence from docs is the only evidence, not an explicit changelog of removed features, since the project is new (2026) and star count is a weak trust signal for a brand-new project.
